neural_anchor.objective: fixed reverse-Bellman FQE teacher MSE plus equal-weight differentiable Bellman-residual MSE on all legal actions
neural_anchor.teacher_semantics: independently recomputed finite-horizon Bellman recurrence from graph,reward,serialized pi_old; no behavior outcome
neural_anchor.release_gate_rationale: Frozen from S4R3 development before any A0/A1/A2 behavior outcome. KeyCorridor has up to millions of finite-horizon state-action entries, so isolated full-table extrema are descriptive; release is governed by aggregate Bellman fidelity and the centered signal and gradient actually consumed by the actor. The same thresholds apply to every task and backbone.

release_retry_rule.trigger: only a preregistered anchor release-gate failure before any behavior outcome
release_retry_rule.seed_and_checkpoint: same prelocked seed; resume the failed checkpoint; no seed replacement
release_retry_rule.scope: only failed heads (both heads if the SAC twin-min aggregate fails); thresholds unchanged

claim_boundary: neural-anchor functional-approximation robustness; not compute efficiency or a propagation-front measurement
